I’ll derive the KG signal from the local `concept_recommended` links, then summarize prescriptions and 7-day coded changes by antimicrobial class.

arguments.sql_query: SELECT TOP 50 relationship_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM omop.concept_recommended GROUP BY relationship_id ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT TOP 100 cr.relationship_id, c1.concept_id AS concept_id_1, c1.concept_name AS concept_1, c1.domain_id AS domain_1, c1.vocabulary_id AS vocab_1, c1.concept_class_id AS class_1, c2.concept_id AS concept_id_2, c2.concept_name AS concept_2, c2.domain_id AS domain_2, c2.vocabulary_id AS vocab_2, c2.concept_class_id AS class_2 FROM omop.concept_recommended cr JOIN omop.concept c1 ON c1.concept_id=cr.concept_id_1 JOIN omop.concept c2 ON c2.concept_id=cr.concept_id_2 WHERE LOWER(cr.relationship_id) LIKE '%resist%' OR LOWER(c1.concept_name) LIKE '%resist%' OR LOWER(c2.concept_name) LIKE '%resist%' ORDER BY cr.relationship_id, c1.concept_name, c2.concept_name

SELECT TOP 50 concept_class_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Drug' AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%antibiotic%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%antibacterial%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%antimicrobial%') GROUP BY concept_class_id ORDER BY n DESC

arguments.sql_query: SELECT TOP 200 c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.domain_id, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_class_id FROM omop.concept c WHERE c.domain_id IN ('Drug','Condition','Observation','Procedure','Measurement') AND (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%treatment%chang%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%change%treatment%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%therapy%chang%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%medication%chang%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%drug%chang%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%regimen%chang%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%switch%therapy%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%antibiotic%chang%') ORDER BY c.domain_id, c.concept_name

SELECT TOP 200 d.concept_id, d.concept_name, d.vocabulary_id, d.concept_class_id, COUNT(*) AS resistance_links FROM ( SELECT cr.concept_id_1 AS drug_id FROM omop.concept_recommended cr JOIN omop.concept c1 ON c1.concept_id=cr.concept_id_1 JOIN omop.concept c2 ON c2.concept_id=cr.concept_id_2 WHERE c1.domain_id='Drug' AND (LOWER(c2.concept_name) LIKE '%resist%' OR LOWER(c2.concept_name) LIKE '%susceptib%') UNION ALL SELECT cr.concept_id_2 AS drug_id FROM omop.concept_recommended cr JOIN omop.concept c1 ON c1.concept_id=cr.concept_id_1 JOIN omop.concept c2 ON c2.concept_id=cr.concept_id_2 WHERE c2.domain_id='Drug' AND (LOWER(c1.concept_name) LIKE '%resist%' OR LOWER(c1.concept_name) LIKE '%susceptib%') ) x JOIN omop.concept d ON d.concept_id=x.drug_id WHERE d.concept_class_id IN ('Ingredient','ATC 3rd','ATC 4th','ATC 5th','ATC 2nd','Substance') GROUP BY d.concept_id, d.concept_name, d.vocabulary_id, d.concept_class_id ORDER BY resistance_links DESC, d.concept_name

I found only a few drug-side KG resistance links after filtering out non-drug false positives; now I’m rolling them up to clinically meaningful antimicrobial classes and counting exposures/change codes.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH class_members AS (
    SELECT 'Beta-lactam penicillins' AS class_name, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 21602818
    UNION
    SELECT 'Vancomycin / glycopeptide' AS class_name, ca.descendant_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 1707687
    UNION
    SELECT 'Tetracyclines' AS class_name, ca.descendant_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 1836948
    UNION
    SELECT 'Anti-staphylococcal penicillins' AS class_name, ca.descendant_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1800835,1724666,1713930,1724703,1361385,19054936)
), change_codes AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
    WHERE domain_id IN ('Observation','Procedure')
      AND (
        LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%treatment changed%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%treatment change%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%medication changed%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%medication change%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%medication therapy changed%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%medical or treatment regimen change%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%regimen change in past 14%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%drug%changed%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%drug%change%'
      )
), drug_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT de.drug_exposure_id, de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date, cm.class_name
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN class_members cm ON cm.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
), flags AS (
    SELECT de.class_name, de.drug_exposure_id,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM omop.observation o JOIN change_codes cc ON cc.concept_id=o.observation_concept_id
               WHERE o.person_id=de.person_id
                 AND o.observation_date >= de.drug_exposure_start_date
                 AND o.observation_date < DATEADD(day, 8, de.drug_exposure_start_date)
           ) OR EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM omop.procedure_occurrence p JOIN change_codes cc ON cc.concept_id=p.procedure_concept_id
               WHERE p.person_id=de.person_id
                 AND p.procedure_date >= de.drug_exposure_start_date
                 AND p.procedure_date < DATEADD(day, 8, de.drug_exposure_start_date)
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_change_7d
    FROM drug_events de
)
SELECT class_name,
       COUNT(*) AS prescriptions,
       SUM(has_change_7d) AS prescriptions_with_change_code_7d,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(has_change_7d) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS DECIMAL(6,3)) AS pct_with_change_code_7d
FROM flags
GROUP BY class_name
ORDER BY prescriptions DESC

arguments.sql_query:
WITH change_codes AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
    WHERE domain_id IN ('Observation','Procedure')
      AND (
        LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%treatment changed%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%treatment change%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%medication changed%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%medication change%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%medication therapy changed%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%medical or treatment regimen change%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%regimen change in past 14%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%drug%changed%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%drug%change%'
      )
), ev AS (
    SELECT o.person_id, o.observation_date AS event_date, 'observation' AS src
    FROM omop.observation o JOIN change_codes cc ON cc.concept_id=o.observation_concept_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.person_id, p.procedure_date AS event_date, 'procedure' AS src
    FROM omop.procedure_occurrence p JOIN change_codes cc ON cc.concept_id=p.procedure_concept_id
)
SELECT src, COUNT_BIG(*) AS coded_change_events, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patients
FROM ev
GROUP BY src

SELECT de.class_name,
       COUNT_BIG(*) AS prescriptions,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ce.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN de.drug_exposure_id END) AS prescriptions_with_change_code_7d,
       CAST(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ce.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN de.drug_exposure_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT_BIG(*),0) AS DECIMAL(8,4)) AS pct_with_change_code_7d
FROM drug_events de
LEFT JOIN change_events ce
  ON ce.person_id = de.person_id
 AND ce.event_date >= de.drug_exposure_start_date
 AND ce.event_date < DATEADD(day, 8, de.drug_exposure_start_date)
GROUP BY de.class_name
ORDER BY prescriptions DESC

Using `medcp` OMOP data, I interpreted KG “high resistance signals” as antimicrobial drug/class concepts linked in `omop.concept_recommended` to resistance/susceptibility-related concepts, then rolled local prescribing through `concept_ancestor`.

| Rank | Resistance-linked antimicrobial class | Local prescriptions | Patients | Treatment-change coded ≤7d | Rate |

| 3 | Anti-staphylococcal penicillins | 23,542 | 4,026 | 0 | 0.0000% |
| 4 | Tetracyclines | 6,780 | 1,609 | 0 | 0.0000% |

Most prescribed: **beta-lactam penicillins**, followed by **vancomycin/glycopeptide**.  
Caveat: “treatment change” was based on generic OMOP observation/procedure concepts such as medication/treatment/regimen changed; only **597 coded change events** were found, so these rates likely reflect **documentation/coding rarity**, not true clinical antibiotic switching.
